audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers of the level chart give Maokai Levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, and give Mordekaiser Level 1. That contradicts the 46.56% win rate over 131 games, the packet levelChart (Skill / Morde / Morde / Morde / Morde / Morde / Skill), and the matchup's own whys[] prose, which says he edges Level 2, out-trades at 3, wins the 4-5 attrition, is a death sentence at 6, out-sustains at first item, and that late game flattens out.
audit.why: Mordekaiser's Obliterate (Q, 8/7/6/5/4s) does bonus damage on an isolated target and Death's Grasp (E, 16/14/12/10/8s) pulls you off the minion line to create that isolation; Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s) shields then heals, beating Sap Magic attrition. Level 1 neither champion has a combo, and late the lane stops mattering because Maokai converts to engage.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill in both layers, with matching ratings and whys.

audit.why: Spikes read Lvl 2-3 (Maokai W-Q + Sap Magic), Lvl 6 (Realm of Death), 1st item (his AP/Magic Pen sustain), Late (Maokai as engage). All four entries present and consistent with the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] 'Stand in his E' is described with text about burning your own ability for tiny value — it never states what Death's Grasp actually does.
audit.why: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in an area toward him; its whole purpose in this matchup is to strip you from the minion wave so Obliterate lands on a single target for its increased damage. That is the decisive interaction of the lane and it was not stated.
audit.corrected: Description now states the pull-into-isolated-Q chain.

audit.why: Realm of Death is correctly identified as the tracked cooldown; 140/120/100s means a missed or baited R is a two-minute window at rank 1.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you has a combo yet — no isolated Obliterate for him, no W-Q chain for you — so Level 1 is a clean farm stage.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Obliterate already out-damages your single knockback if you step up, and Indestructible shields the chip you land — he edges Level 2.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: With Q-W-E online he slams you isolated and shields the return — keep the wave stacked by him so Obliterate drops to its weak hit.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Death's Grasp keeps pulling you off the wave for an isolated Obliterate, and Indestructible heals through Sap Magic — attrition tilts his way.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Realm of Death drags you into a 1v1 and steals your resistances — it is a 140s cooldown at rank 1, so never face him alone while it is up.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Realm of Death's cooldown.
edits.after: AP and Magic Pen make his Q-W sustain outpace your flat damage — Heartsteel buys HP, not a duel.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: It flattens out: you stop dueling and become the engage — Nature's Grasp and W lockdown start fights his single-target R cannot answer.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It pulls you off the wave so Obliterate lands isolated for bonus damage.

notes: Level chart was wrong in BOTH layers relative to the packet chart, the 46.56% win rate, and the matchup's own whys[] prose; all seven rows now proposed as one matched full+content group. Realm of Death duration and stat-steal percentages are not in the kit text, so no numbers were asserted beyond the 140/120/100s cooldown.
